import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX = 31;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static int n;
    static long[][] mat = new long[MAX][MAX];

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] t = new long[MAX][MAX];

        void init() {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    t[i][j] = (i == j) ? 1 : 0;
                }
            }
        }

        void mul(Matrix b) {
            long[][] temp = new long[n][n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    temp[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        temp[i][k] = (temp[i][k] + this.t[i][j] * b.t[j][k]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                System.arraycopy(temp[i], 0, this.t[i], 0, n);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long m_in = sc.nextLong();
        int k_in = sc.nextInt();

        long m_value = m_in;
        int k_value = k_in;

        List<Long> digits = new ArrayList<>();
        while (m_value != 0) {
            digits.add(m_value % k_value);
            m_value /= k_value;
        }

        n = k_value + 1;

        Matrix base = new Matrix();
        Matrix identity = new Matrix();

        // Initialize base matrix
        for (int i = 0; i < k_value; i++) {
            base.t[i][(i + 1) % k_value] = 1;
        }
        base.t[k_value][k_value] = 1;

        // Initialize identity matrix
        identity.init();

        // Set first row and diagonal
        for (int i = 0; i <= k_value; i++) {
            base.t[0][i] = 1;
            base.t[i][i] = 1;
        }

        List<Matrix> d = new ArrayList<>();
        // First power
        Matrix firstD = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(identity.t[i], 0, firstD.t[i], 0, n);
        }
        firstD.mul(base);
        d.add(firstD);

        // Compute subsequent powers
        for (int i = 1; i < digits.size(); i++) {
            Matrix prev = d.get(i - 1);
            Matrix curr = new Matrix();
            // Square the previous matrix
            for (int r = 0; r < n; r++) {
                System.arraycopy(prev.t[r], 0, curr.t[r], 0, n);
            }
            for (int _ = 0; _ < k_value; _++) {
                curr.mul(curr);
            }
            curr.mul(base);
            d.add(curr);
        }

        long[] ans = new long[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ans[i] = 1;
        }

        for (int idx = digits.size() - 1; idx >= 0; idx--) {
            long[] powArr = new long[n];
            for (int _ = 0; _ < digits.get(idx); _++) {
                long[] newAns = new long[n];
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                        newAns[j] = (newAns[j] + ans[i] * d.get(idx).t[i][j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
                ans = newAns;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(ans[k_value]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
